item.title: Defensive coordinator job brings Anthony Weaver back to Ravens
item.description: OWINGS MILLS, Md. — Anthony Weaver is back for another stint with the Baltimore Ravens.

item.title: Raiders introduce new coach Klint Kubiak with nod to storied past
item.description: HENDERSON, Nev. — They were introduced one by one, six ex-players who represent Raiders royalty. Four Hall of Famers. Five Super Bowl champions. All six at least made the big game.

item.title: Trump to direct Pentagon to buy coal in bid to revive industry
item.description: WASHINGTON — President Donald Trump will introduce plans to use government funding and Pentagon contracts to sustain U.S. coal-fired power plants as he seeks to drive domestic reliance on the fossil fuel.

item.title: Penn State student on life support after hit-and-run crash in State College, family says
item.description: A Penn State student is in critical condition and expected to remain in an intensive care unit for at least a month after she was hit Saturday by a driver in downtown State College.

item.title: U.S. Rep. Ro Khanna names 6 men in Epstein files, calls for tech elite who visited island to be investigated
item.description: Congressman Ro Khanna stood on the House floor Tuesday and revealed the names of six powerful men — most of them not widely known — he implied were implicated but improperly blacked out from newly released case files on late financier and alleged sex trafficker Jeffrey Epstein.

item.title: Landslide closes part of Route 28 southbound between the Hulton Bridge, Powers Run Road
item.description: A southbound lane of Route 28 is closed between the Hulton Bridge in Oakmont and Powers Run Road following a landslide Tuesday evening.

item.title: Pitt starts hot, hangs tough with No. 4 Duke, but Blue Devils pull away for rout
item.description: A few minutes into Tuesday’s game between Pitt and No. 4 Duke, the Panthers were reacquainted with an advantage unseen for quite some time at Petersen Events Center: energetic cheering from a large crowd.

item.title: High school roundup for Feb. 10, 2026: Ambridge wins to wrap up WPIAL regular season
item.description: Jared Astorino scored 26 points to lead Ambridge to a 75-57 nonsection boys basketball victory over St. Joseph to wrap up the WPIAL regular season Tuesday night.

Sharpsburg continues to rack up funding for multimillion-dollar Allegheny Shores development
item.description: Transformation of the Sharpsburg riverfront continues to chug along, with officials shoring up streetscape plans expected to improve safety and access to the site.
